source: Cloudflare Dashboard evidence collected 2026-10-20; historical, not a fresh quota measurement

fingerprints.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (gpa > ? OR (gpa = ? AND training_score > ?)
  OR (gpa = ? AND training_score = ? AND credits > ?)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outranking
       FROM semester_exact_rankings
      WHERE semester = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (gpa > ? OR (gpa = ? AND training_score > ?)
  OR (gpa = ? AND training_score = ? AND credits > ?)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outranking
       FROM semester_exact_rankings
      WHERE semester = ? AND major = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (gpa > ? OR (gpa = ? AND training_score > ?)

       FROM semester_exact_rankings
      WHERE semester = ? AND class_code = ?
